styles.name: musical-staff
styles.description: Five-line staff with a treble clef; stemmed notes are written left-to-right as progress grows while a playhead lights them in turn

styles.name: piano-keyboard
styles.description: Piano keyboard with black keys in groups of two and three; keys light up left-to-right with progress while a melody presses them

styles.name: metronome
styles.description: Wooden pyramid metronome swinging its weighted pendulum; beat ticks light up to its right as progress grows

styles.name: vinyl-record
styles.description: Turntable with a spinning grooved record and red label; the tonearm's stylus tracks inward and played grooves dim with progress

styles.name: drum-kit
styles.description: Front-on drum kit that assembles piece by piece with progress while a rock groove flashes the kick, snare and cymbals

styles.name: sound-waveform
styles.description: Centered oscillating waveform; amplitude grows with progress, morph sine→saw with time

styles.name: cassette-reels
styles.description: Compact cassette whose spoked reels turn while tape winds from the left pack to the right and the label strip fills with progress

styles.name: conductor-baton
styles.description: Tailcoated conductor whose baton traces the 4/4 beat pattern; eighth notes stream out across the stage as progress grows

styles.name: sheet-scroll
styles.description: Paper scroll of sheet music between two rollers; notes slide past and the paper winds onto the left roll as progress grows

styles.name: tuning-fork
styles.description: Steel tuning fork on its side with buzzing tines; sound-wave arcs ripple out further with progress

styles.name: volume-knob
styles.description: Amp volume knob turning up its 7-to-5 o'clock tick scale with progress, beside a dancing stereo LED meter

styles.name: beat-pulse
styles.description: Concentric rings expanding outward on each beat; ring density grows with progress

styles.name: acoustic-guitar
styles.description: Acoustic guitar with headstock, fretted neck and sound-holed body; a fretting finger slides up the neck with progress while strummed strings ring

styles.name: trumpet
styles.description: Trumpet in profile with flared bell, tubing loop and three piston valves pressing a fanfare; the brass lights from mouthpiece to bell with progress
